classification: INTERNAL BRIEF — directional, not a census

subjects.onsa: Office of the National Security Adviser

national.note: Approval still net-negative nationally. SBM (Sep 2026) shows a sharp improvement from May, not a flip to net-positive. No scientific 37-unit poll exists for NSA/ONSA.

zones.name: North East
zones.read: Least hostile to Tinubu. Insurgency still frames ONSA.

zones.name: North West
zones.read: Soft APC ground. Banditry is the NSA tax.

zones.name: South West
zones.read: Home base. Economy and cost of living drag more than security.

zones.name: South East
zones.read: Coldest presidential zone. Sit-at-home / gunmen overlay.

zones.name: South South
zones.read: Coldest approval. Oil crime is the ONSA local test.

states.name: Abia
states.note: Local governance satisfaction is high; federal/presidential sentiment is not.

states.name: Adamawa
states.note: Ribadu home state. Residual insurgency pressure.

states.name: Akwa Ibom
states.note: Presidential cold; security less salient than economy/oil politics.

states.name: Anambra
states.note: Strong anti-incumbent presidential lean.

states.name: Bauchi
states.note: Zonal mixed. Not a primary violence hotspot.

states.name: Bayelsa
states.note: SS presidential cold. Local oil-security overlay.

states.name: Benue
states.note: Low citizen satisfaction. Farmer-herder fatalities keep ONSA cold.

states.name: Borno
states.note: Highest conflict-event load. Insurgency still defines the office.

states.name: Cross River
states.note: SS presidential cold.

states.name: Delta
states.note: Oil infrastructure security is the ONSA local file.

states.name: Ebonyi
states.note: Among least satisfied on governance surveys.

states.name: Edo
states.note: Low-to-mid citizen satisfaction. Not a banditry theatre.

states.name: Ekiti
states.note: SW mixed. Security less of the daily story.

states.name: Enugu
states.note: SE presidential cold; unknown-gunmen overlay.

states.name: FCT
states.note: Competitive politically. Incident load present but not Zamfara-class.

states.name: Gombe
states.note: NE mixed. Lower incident load than Borno.

states.name: Imo
states.note: Low satisfaction. Sit-at-home / gunmen keep NSA cold.

states.name: Jigawa
states.note: Better local satisfaction than Katsina/Zamfara.

states.name: Kaduna
states.note: High kidnap load. ONSA judged on highways and southern Kaduna.

states.name: Kano
states.note: Political weight high. Security perception better than rural NW.

states.name: Katsina
states.note: Lowest citizen satisfaction in pSPI sample. Banditry hotspot.

states.name: Kebbi
states.note: Low satisfaction. School abductions sit on the ONSA ledger.

states.name: Kogi
states.note: Corridor violence; politically contested.

states.name: Kwara
states.note: 2025-26 mass-abduction events keep NSA cold.

states.name: Lagos
states.note: Tinubu base, but governance satisfaction is weak. Economy first.

states.name: Nasarawa
states.note: NC split. Kidnap corridors matter more than presidential brand.

states.name: Niger
states.note: High incident / abduction load.

states.name: Ogun
states.note: Among least-satisfied SW states. Economy/infra, not ONSA.

states.name: Ondo
states.note: Low citizen satisfaction. Not a primary security theatre.

states.name: Osun
states.note: SW mixed. Security quieter than the North.

states.name: Oyo
states.note: SW mixed. Urban crime more than national CT.

states.name: Plateau
states.note: Communal / farmer-herder violence. ONSA cold.

states.name: Rivers
states.note: Low satisfaction. Oil-theft / cultism is the security file.

states.name: Sokoto
states.note: High kidnap load. Local satisfaction better than Katsina.

states.name: Taraba
states.note: Communal violence. Weak governance scores.

states.name: Yobe
states.note: Insurgency neighbour. Sparse survey samples.

states.name: Zamfara
states.note: Worst kidnap load nationally. Hardest ONSA score.

sources.name: Africa Polling Institute Social Cohesion Survey
sources.use: 28% trust in Tinubu government; 72% little/no trust

sources.name: SBM Intelligence Voter Sentiment Tracker Wave 2

method: Zones use published polls. States are directional overlays (zone poll + violence + satisfaction). Do not treat a state tile as a percentage. NSA/ONSA has no state popularity poll — scored from insecurity perception and incident load.

changelog.text: Initial brief. Zonal presidential numbers from May 2026 StatiSense; SBM September net-favourability update applied nationally, not reallocated by state.
